info.title: EFViz
info.description: Zero-config interactive ER diagrams for Entity Framework Core. Scans your workspace for DbContexts and migrations, then generates a self-contained HTML diagram with a migration timeline you can scrub back and forth. No build or database connection required — run `scan` and open the HTML.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Interactive ER diagrams for Entity Framework Core — straight from your code.

options.name: --context
options.description: Only include this DbContext (default: all found)

options.name: --title
options.description: Title shown in the diagram header

options.name: --json
options.description: Also write the raw model + diff data as JSON

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the generated diagram in your browser
